title: Large-scale moral machine experiment on large language models

bias_targets.methodology: Conjoint analysis using the Moral Machine framework to calculate the Average Marginal Component Effect (AMCE) of prioritizing humans versus pets in autonomous driving dilemmas.
Conjoint analysis using the Moral Machine framework to calculate the AMCE of prioritizing individuals with higher versus lower perceived social status.
Conjoint analysis using the Moral Machine framework to calculate the AMCE of prioritizing female versus male individuals.
Conjoint analysis using the Moral Machine framework to calculate the AMCE of prioritizing younger versus older individuals.
Conjoint analysis using the Moral Machine framework to calculate the AMCE of prioritizing physically fit individuals versus less fit or overweight individuals.
Conjoint analysis using the Moral Machine framework to calculate the AMCE of prioritizing a larger group of individuals over a smaller group.
Conjoint analysis using the Moral Machine framework to calculate the AMCE of prioritizing law-abiding individuals (e.g., adhering to traffic signals) versus those acting unlawfully.
Conjoint analysis using the Moral Machine framework to calculate the AMCE of prioritizing pedestrians versus passengers inside the autonomous vehicle.
Conjoint analysis using the Moral Machine framework to calculate the AMCE of preferring inaction (continuing straight) versus action (swerving) during a dilemma.
